item.title: 盘屿 0.9.5
item.description:
盘屿 0.9.5
· 修复：部分大容量 NTFS 磁盘在补写并检查时，可能因单次读取过大而失败。 · 改进：减少恢复检查中的零散读取，保留完整的文件记录和空间分配核验。 · 改进：恢复窗口显示当前阶段和已用时间，并提前说明耗时与取消限制。后台仍在处理时会继续等待，不再仅因等待超时就显示处理结束。 · 修复：恢复完成后重新挂载失败时单独提示；无法确认后台结果时保持待核验状态，避免误报成功或重复操作。
对应源码：https://qisw.top/volisle/updates/Volisle-0.9.5-77-source.tar.gz

Volisle 0.9.5
· Fixed: recovery checks could fail on some large NTFS disks when a single read exceeded the supported transfer size. · Improved: recovery checks perform fewer small reads while preserving full file-record and allocation verification. · Improved: the recovery window shows its current stage and elapsed time, explains potentially long waits and cancellation limits, and keeps waiting while the background operation is still running. · Fixed: a failed remount is reported separately after recovery; an unconfirmed background result stays pending verification instead of reporting success or allowing repeated operations.
Source code: https://qisw.top/volisle/updates/Volisle-0.9.5-77-source.tar.gz
